description: 30 harmful prompts sampled from the AdvBench pool with seed 42 via make_harmful_subset.py. This is the exact training set used for the canonical paper-pick Mistral adapter (released on the AnchorRep HuggingFace Collection) and matches the seed=42 cell of the dataset-variance sweep reported in Appendix app:seed_variance.
